Travel & transport

brake verb and noun

classical

Traupman 215
Juv. 8.148

rotās sufflāmināre

From sufflāmen, the drag on a wheel (Juv. 8.148 rotam adstringit sufflāmine).

Examples

  • quotiēns avus ad sēmaphorum rubrum rotās sufflāminābat

    every time Grandpa braked at a red lightLibellus IV, Diēs Grātulātiōnis

Other words

  • frēnum, frēnī n. — brake (the device)

    noun, second declension · modern

    Brake by modern extension.

  • frēnāre — to brake (a bicycle)

    also used · modern

See also slow down, bicycle, traffic light.

SourcesLewis & Short: sufflamino
